name: Coffee
description: Provides an Alfred like search box to navigate within your site.
project_description:
Tired of wasting time navigating through endless menus in the Drupal admin? Meet Coffee , the ultimate tool to streamline your workflow. Inspired by Mac’s Alfred and Spotlight, Coffee lets you quickly access any admin page with just a few keystrokes—no more clicking around!

 Why Choose Coffee? 
 Speed & Efficiency 
 With Coffee, navigating your Drupal admin is faster than ever. Simply press Alt + D and start typing to instantly find the page or task you're looking for. Spend less time searching, and more time doing.

 Seamless Keyboard Navigation 
 Love using keyboard shortcuts? Coffee lets you access any page directly from your keyboard. Whether you’re managing content, tweaking site settings, or adjusting themes, Coffee makes it lightning fast.

 Quick Content Creation 
 Need to add content fast? Use the

command to instantly create new posts, pages, or custom content types—all without lifting your hands from the keyboard.

 How does it work? 
 
 Activate Coffee with Alt + D (or Alt + Shift + D in Opera, Alt + Ctrl + D in Internet Explorer) or the alternative Alt + K. 
 Type just the first few characters of the admin page or task you need, and Coffee will take you there in seconds. 
 If there are multiple results, simply use the arrow keys to select what you need and hit Enter. 
 
 For a full demonstration of Coffee in action, check out this video tutorial. 

 Built for Developers too! 
 Want more control? Coffee is fully customizable. Developers can easily add their own commands using hook_coffee_command(), allowing for even greater flexibility in navigating custom admin tasks. Check out coffee.api.php for more details.

 Drupal 7 Support 
 Still on Drupal 7? The Coffee module for Drupal 7 is now part of the D7Security project, ensuring continued long-term support. Learn more about how to contribute and stay secure by visiting the user guide.

 Ready to Boost Your Productivity? 
 Start saving time today by installing Coffee on your Drupal site. Experience faster, smarter navigation that transforms your admin workflow.
